description: 🎲 What the betting crowd expects for a coin's price — real-money Polymarket price markets, free, public. With `symbol`: the crowd's 50/50 price for the next few days (and the chance it ends above each level), and the chance it reaches or dips to the levels people bet on this month and this year. Without `symbol`: every coin that has price bets right now (only big coins: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, Hyperliquid…). Use for 'what does Polymarket expect for X', 'odds BTC hits 100k', and next to Asrai's own outlooks to say whether the crowd agrees. It is the crowd's bet, not Asrai's forecast.

symbol.description: Optional coin, e.g. BTC. Leave out to list every coin with bets
